source_notes: Compiled 2026-11-13. Teams/levels/moves: decompilation data from github.com/pret (pokered, pokeyellow, pokegold, pokecrystal, pokeruby, pokeemerald, pokefirered, pokeplatinum, pokeheartgold) because Bulbapedia blocks automated access; dex numbers and move identifiers via PokeAPI. Diamond/Pearl (no usable decomp): teams, levels and moves from PokeWiki (pokewiki.de) pages of each leader/Top-Vier member/Champ, German move and species names mapped to PokeAPI identifiers via PokeAPI German names; E4/Champ send-out order cross-checked with Serebii. German names and cities from PokeWiki (Arenaleiter page, Top Vier Kanto/Johto/Hoenn/Sinnoh pages, individual pages for Siegfried, Janina, Juan, Troy, Cynthia, Rot, Blau). Gen 1 (red-blue, yellow): moves are not stored in the ROM trainer data, so they were computed with the games own rule (base moves + level-up learnset up to the level, last four) plus the special moves from pret (LoneMoves/TeamMoves and Yellow SpecialTrainerMoves). Gold/Silver and Crystal also include the Kanto leaders (order 9-16, canonical Kanto order, can be done in any order) and Red (kind special, Mt. Silver); HGSS likewise (Kanto leaders order 9-16, Blue = Vertania City leader, Red special). Platinum gym order: Fantina 3rd, Maylene 4th; Diamond/Pearl: Maylene 3rd, Wake 4th, Fantina 5th. Champions/rivals without a type specialty have type null. Rival name_de is Blau (PokeWiki full name Blau Eich). Pokemon with fewer than 4 moves in moves[] really have fewer moves in the ROM data (e.g. Roark Geodude).

bosses.variant: Eevee evolved to Jolteon: player won the Oak's Lab AND the Route 22 rival battle
Eevee evolved to Flareon: player won the Oak's Lab battle but skipped or lost the Route 22 battle
Eevee evolved to Vaporeon: player lost the Oak's Lab battle
